newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU links Bosnian Serb aid to Karadic arrest.
newsitem.headline: EU links Bosnian Serb aid to Karadic arrest.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it would not provide the Bosnian Serb government with promised aid this year unless indicted war criminal Radovan Karadic was arrested.

"The conditions of the Dayton (peace) agreement are very clear: war criminals must be handed to the War Crimes Tribunal if reconstruction aid is to be provided," External Affairs Commissioner Hans van den Broek said in a statement.

The statement said the Republika Srpska, the Serb portion of Bosnia-Herzegovina, was due to receive 30 million European currency units ($34 million) from the Commission this year in aid to repair roads, telecommunications links and other reconstruction projects.
The Commission said the freeze on aid did not apply to humanitarian assistance.
Karadzic, the former Serb leader, has been indicted by the U.N. War Crimes Tribunal in the Hague.
